Hi Maya — great to connect yesterday. High level answers below; I’ve attached our BYOK integration guide and a condensed evidence pack. Happy to walk through live if helpful.

Quick summary (full responses attached):

1) BYOK / key import
- We support customer-managed keys via BYOK: customers can import HSM-protected keys into Redwood using an industry-standard envelope-wrapping flow. Import is performed into an HSM-backed key store; keys are marked non-exportable from the HSM.
- Supported KMS integrations: AWS KMS (customer-managed CMKs), Azure Key Vault, Google Cloud KMS, and PKCS#11-based HSMs for private deployments.
- For cloud KMS integrations we use envelope encryption where the customer key (CMK) protects a service key; customer retains full control of the CMK policy and can revoke access at any time.

2) HSM / attestation
- Production HSMs are provided by vetted vendors (Thales/Entrust/HSM provider partners) with FIPS 140-2 Level 3 attestations on our hosted HSMs. For Dedicated/Private customers we support FIPS-validated HSMs deployed in-customer or in a customer-dedicated tenancy.
- We can provide HSM vendor attestation letters and FIPS certificate scans under NDA; sample attestation is included in the evidence pack.

3) Key rotation & lifecycle
- Default rotation cadence for service-encryption keys: 90 days; customers can configure rotation frequency for envelope keys and bring own rotation cadence for their CMKs via their KMS.
- Rotation is atomic from the service perspective (new key created, active usage begins after KV update, old key retained for decrypt until retention window ends).
- Emergency key-revocation and rewrap procedures documented; we provide playbooks and sample automation scripts.

4) TLS & network
- Public API: TLS 1.2 (1.2 minimum), TLS 1.3 supported and preferred; recommended cipher suites provided in attachment.
- Private/VPC: mutual TLS (mTLS) supported for private endpoints; customer-managed client certs accepted. Certificate rotation supported via customer-driven PKI or via ACME for managed certs.
- We support enforcing minimum TLS versions at the route level and can provide per-route cipher control for Dedicated customers.

5) Audit logging & controls
- All key management ops (import, rotate, bind, policy changes) are logged with user/principal, timestamp, request context, and outcome. Logs are retained per customer-configurable retention windows and can be exported to customer SIEMs (S3, GCS, syslog).
- Role separation: key administration, key usage, and security audit roles are separated; RBAC and SCIM provisioning supported.

Artifacts attached / links:
- redwood-byok-integration-guide.pdf (attached)
- Condensed evidence pack (HSM attestation excerpt, sample audit log entries, cipher config)
- Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/concordia/onboarding/BYOK-integration-guide

Delivery timeline
- We can provide the attestation extracts and sample logs by EOD Aug 8 under the standard NDA. Full HSM vendor certs and signed statements may require an NDA amendment; we’ll flag any PII/contractual restrictions.

Next steps
- I’ll share the evidence pack now and loop Marcus (ops) and Neha (security) for any follow-ups. If you want a walkthrough, propose Tue Aug 10 10:00-11:00 ET and we’ll reserve time.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
